kobe-arima-onsen-kin-no-yu.approx_cost: ¥650 weekdays, ¥800 weekends/holidays and peak periods (adults); children ¥350; combined Kin no Yu + Gin no Yu ticket ¥1,200 (third-party figures, not confirmed after the 2026 reopening)
kobe-arima-onsen-kin-no-yu.address_local: 〒651-1401 兵庫県神戸市北区有馬町

kobe-ikuta-shrine.name: Ikuta Shrine
kobe-ikuta-shrine.hours: 7:00-17:00 per a 2026 listing (not confirmed by the shrine)

kobe-kitano-weathercock-house.name: Weathercock House (Kitano Ijinkan)
kobe-kitano-weathercock-house.approx_cost: ¥500 (adults); combined ticket with Moegi House ¥800 since 1 Apr 2026 (was ¥650); high-school age and under free

kobe-luminarie.name: Kobe Luminarie
kobe-luminarie.recurrence: yearly, late January–early February (10 days in 2027)

editions.note: 32nd edition; Meriken Park (partly paid area), Higashi Yuenchi and the former foreign settlement; lit from dusk to about 21:30 (based on previous edition)

kobe-luminarie.approx_cost: Most areas free; paid area in Meriken Park — previous edition: advance ¥500 weekdays / ¥750 weekends, same day ¥1,000 / ¥1,500 (2027 prices not confirmed)

kobe-matsuri.name: Kobe Matsuri
kobe-matsuri.recurrence: yearly, main festival on a Sunday in mid-May (3rd Sunday in 2026 and 2027)

editions.note: 54th edition (planned); parade and main festival around Higashi Yuenchi and the former foreign settlement

kobe-mount-rokko.name: Mount Rokko (Rokko Cable & Rokko Garden Terrace)
kobe-mount-rokko.approx_cost: Rokko Cable adults ¥800 one way (fare raised Apr 2025) / ¥1,550 round trip; Rokko Sanjo Bus extra; viewpoints at Garden Terrace free
kobe-mount-rokko.hours: Rokko Cable ~7:10-21:10 (every 20 min); Rokko Garden Terrace shops mostly 9:30-20:00 (varies by shop)
kobe-mount-rokko.best_season: all year; night view best on clear evenings
kobe-mount-rokko.name_local: 六甲山(六甲ケーブル・六甲ガーデンテラス)

kobe-nankinmachi.name: Nankinmachi (Kobe Chinatown)
kobe-nankinmachi.approx_cost: free to walk; street food a few hundred yen per item
kobe-nankinmachi.hours: Street always open; shops and stalls roughly 11:00-21:00, varying by shop
kobe-nankinmachi.address_local: 〒650-0023 兵庫県神戸市中央区栄町通三丁目元町パークロード

kobe-nunobiki-herb-gardens-ropeway.name: Kobe Nunobiki Herb Gardens & Ropeway
kobe-nunobiki-herb-gardens-ropeway.approx_cost: Ropeway round trip + garden ¥2,500 adults (since 1 Apr 2026), ¥1,250 children; one way ¥1,900; night fare after 17:00 ¥2,000 (not offered in summer and Christmas seasons); special fares 7 Nov–25 Dec 2026
kobe-nunobiki-herb-gardens-ropeway.hours: Ropeway uphill basically 9:30-16:45; until 20:15 on many weekends/holidays, in summer and in the Christmas season (2026: 7 Nov–6 Dec Fri–Sun & holidays, 11–25 Dec daily); garden hours vary by season

closed.irregular: Ropeway and gardens closed for inspection 2027-01-23 to 2027-02-12 (also 2026-08-31 to 09-03); suspended in strong wind or thunder

kobe-nunobiki-herb-gardens-ropeway.best_season: spring to autumn; Christmas illumination season Nov–Dec
kobe-nunobiki-herb-gardens-ropeway.name_local: 神戸布引ハーブ園/ロープウェイ

kobe-port-tower.name: Kobe Port Tower
kobe-port-tower.approx_cost: ¥1,200 adults observation floor + rooftop deck; ¥1,000 observation floor only; children ¥500 / ¥400; 65+ half price
kobe-port-tower.hours: Observation floor (5F) and rooftop deck 9:00-23:00 (2026 listings); other floors vary
kobe-port-tower.address_local: 〒650-0042 兵庫県神戸市中央区波止場町5

osaka-to-kobe.name: Osaka ↔ Kobe
osaka-to-kobe.approx_cost: Hankyu limited express Osaka-umeda → Kobe-sannomiya ~28 min ¥330; JR Special Rapid Osaka → Sannomiya ~21–25 min ¥420; Hanshin Osaka-umeda → Kobe-sannomiya ~40 min ¥330. No reservation needed.
